name: fetch_linkedin_posts
description: Fetch a person's own recent LinkedIn posts through a scraper key the person connected (Monid or Apify, each an OpenAPI connection in Lemma). Writes /people/<handle>/voice/posts.md and posts.json, and saves the images from their own posts under /people/<handle>/voice/images/. With estimate_only it calls nothing and returns the most it could cost. Costs money: say the estimate and get a yes before running it for real. Ships with no key.
